Research Scholarships

Swansea University offers a number of awards for students pursuing PhD, MPhil, MRes or Master's by Research studies.  There are also a range of postgraduate scholarships for international students at various points throughout the year.  Please visit: our pages on international scholarships to see what scholarships are currently available.

Due to the high volume of applications, we are unable to provide feedback on decisions made prior to the interview stage. Unsuccessful applications at this point are typically the result of strong competition for a limited number of places. Applicants rejected following scholarship interview can receive feedback on request. 

Applications may be submitted in Welsh and any application submitted in Welsh will be treated no less favourably than an application submitted in English. Please refer to the University’s Welsh Language Policy on Awarding Grants

Awards are listed in closing date order then alphabetically by subject below, and are updated regularly.
